plain: Lasting or happening every six years

webster.text: Lasting six years, or happening once in six years.

example.quote: Further, this sexennial senate of 26 members, representing 13 sovereign states, will not, in practice, be found to be a body to advise, but to order and dictate in fact; and the president will be a mere primus inter pares.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XIII, Jan. 14, 1788
